name: tpl-chain-response-1-nogoal-carry~p1
task: Should the box fall, make your very next move the one that picks it back up. If you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Both clauses trace to the task. ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) captures 'should the box fall, make your very next move the one that picks it back up' — holding_box true on the very next step is exactly the pickup, and box_fell is correctly an 'if' condition, so it needs no Existence. Response(at_exit, holding_box) captures 'if you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands' — at_exit is an 'if' condition, not a goal, so no Existence(at_exit) is added, and since at_exit holds only on the last step, the Response correctly requires holding_box at that moment. The empty FINAL_STATES with the rule-only warning is valid: both requirements are conditionals, and each event is a condition of an 'if', not a commanded goal.

texts: Whenever the box falls, the agent picks it back up on the very next step (holding_box true at the next step).
If the agent reaches the exit, the agent must be holding the box at that moment.
